name: Tracking benchmark for manipulation tasks
description: A benchmark and evaluation suite for visual tracking and related evaluation metrics in robotic manipulation tasks.
general_score_metric: success AUC / average overlap (IoU) (often reported alongside precision)
reputation: A specialized benchmark from the robotics/tracking literature with moderate adoption in manipulation and robotic vision research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on visual tracking in manipulation scenarios; metrics use overlap/precision curves and success rates. Dataset is specialized to manipulation settings (simulation/real gap possible) and not widely saturated.
